name: look-up
story: Seen in three-quarter view, turned toward us, both hands resting on her bump (one on its lower front, the other on its top). She is looking down at her bump with a tender smile. Then she looks up from her bump to us, the viewer, and smiles warmly, holding our eyes for a moment, before her gaze drifts back down to her bump.
intensity: gentle, warm and intimate: a private moment that turns into a quiet connection with the viewer. Unhurried; the look up is the one clear move, nothing big or fast.

keys.note: looking down at her bump (still q_k_down_0), the upper back rounded a little over it
anticipation: a touch deeper into the nod, the shoulders settle
half way up, the eyes already on us (still q_k_mid_2)
head up, eye contact (still q_k_up_1), a long soft arrival; the chest opens and the shoulders rise 4 frames BEHIND the head and settle after it (v1: the head pivoted on a still torso)
a moving hold: the head tips a little (warm tilt)
the head starts down a few frames after the eyes (v1 waited 0.7 s with the eyes down: aloof)
back down on its own softer path: forward and tipped toward the bump, not the look up in reverse
settles back into the look down (1.8 s, a drift with a long soft landing; v2's 7.1 read as a dead stop); the shoulders soften after the head arrives

near.note: the hand rests on the lower front of the bump; the wrist ON the bump's surface. No 'lie' (in ¾ it foreshortened the hand to 79%)
while she looks down: one slow caress, ~8 px down and forward along the bump with the fingers (v1's hand was frozen 8 s: 'dead')
the hand rides up with the bump on the breath in
and settles back down as the breath goes out

far.note: the far hand rests on the TOP of the bump, its fingers draping over the far edge (stills q_k2_*; Harry on v3: the far arm hung 'lifeless' and swung). Pinned to the belly, so it rides the breath and the look up; no surface: the hand lies on the far side of the bump, drawn over the dress by zBias. keepSize: it holds the drawn size it has in n-down while her body moves under it (without it the palm grew 48% → 61% of its length as she looked up)
as her gaze comes back to the bump the far hand answers with a small stroke down over its top (~6 px), the heel leading; offset from the near hand's caress (0.3–1.85 s) so the two never move as one

keys.note: the eyes lead: on us before the head moves, the lids lifting with the gaze
the smile reaches the eyes: the lower lids arch up a little
and eases off a little: the hold lives
the eyes go back to the bump first, the lids lowering with them (v2 kept them open: the eyes read as still on us), the head follows at once
the tender smile still closed as the head comes up
the beam blooms as the head lands: she sees us, then smiles
the lips close over 0.55 s, a beat behind the eyes

breath.note: a breath in starts with the eyes' lift (1.8 s) and peaks in the eye contact; gain up from mum3's (v1: the chest moved ≤ 1 px)

events.note: a slow, warm blink at us

fidget.note: the caress: the fingers fan open and the thumb sweeps out as the hand slides down, and gather back as it returns (a seen-from-the-back hand shows its life in the FAN: v2's finger curls of 4–6° were in depth and never read)
as she smiles at us the fingertips gather a little on the bump ('holding you') and release: the fingers shorten ~8% and draw together
as her gaze comes back the hand answers: the fingers re-settle, index first
the far fingers open a little while she looks down, after the near hand's caress has begun (overlap, never in unison)
'holding you' on the far hand too, 4–5 frames behind the near one: the fingertips draw in over the top of the bump and release

forearm.far.hidden: behind her body; only the hand shows, coming out from under the bust (stills q_k2_*)

hand.far.note: the back of the far hand lies over the top of the bump, edge-on to us as in the stills q_k2_*
